purpose: 准备发布版本、旧清单、新模板和两组依赖文件。
观察新增类别证据变化时，相关进度重置，而补丁类别进度保留。
command: /usr/bin/python3 release_desk.py --store demo/releases.json migrate-checklist 1.0.0 2.0.0 demo/old.json demo/template.json --base-dependencies demo/base.json --dependencies demo/dependencies.json
output: {"baseVersion": "1.0.0", "version": "2.0.0", "items": [{"id": "patch", "text": "Confirm patch", "required": true, "status": "done"}, {"id": "feature", "text": "Confirm feature", "required": true, "status": "pending"}, {"id": "approval", "text": "Release approval", "required": true, "status": "pending"}], "retained": ["patch"], "reset": ["feature", "approval"], "added": [], "removed": ["legacy"], "dependencies": {"patch": [], "feature": ["patch"], "approval": []}, "includedPrerequisites": []}

purpose: 观察证据仅改变顺序时，新增间接前置项补入并传播重置，独立审批保留。
command: /usr/bin/python3 release_desk.py --store demo/releases.json migrate-checklist 1.0.0 3.0.0 demo/old.json demo/template.json --base-dependencies demo/base.json --dependencies demo/revised-dependencies.json
output: {"baseVersion": "1.0.0", "version": "3.0.0", "items": [{"id": "preflight", "text": "Validate prerequisite", "required": false, "status": "pending"}, {"id": "patch", "text": "Confirm patch", "required": true, "status": "pending"}, {"id": "feature", "text": "Confirm feature", "required": true, "status": "pending"}, {"id": "approval", "text": "Release approval", "required": true, "status": "done"}], "retained": ["approval"], "reset": ["patch", "feature"], "added": ["preflight"], "removed": ["legacy"], "dependencies": {"preflight": [], "patch": ["preflight"], "feature": ["patch"], "approval": []}, "includedPrerequisites": ["preflight"]}
